portable_runtime.ownership: System owns shared TUI implementation; Business Tools applications consume it.
portable_runtime.capability_discovery: Report supported services, limits and usable display configurations.
portable_runtime.abi_policy: Stable binary interfaces within this target; shared C API across targets.

forward_compatibility_commitment.scope: Released Artemis application binaries using documented, supported ERA/AIONix interfaces retain a supported execution path on subsequent Logix professional platforms through 2000: native execution, a maintained compatibility runtime, or emulation. Source portability is a separate commitment, not a substitute for the binary execution path.
forward_compatibility_commitment.exclusions: Undocumented hardware access, unqualified peripherals and unsupported interfaces; no promise of unchanged speed, unlimited memory, or every future device. Z80 programs use their separately qualified compatibility path.
forward_compatibility_commitment.delivery_requirements: Publish versioned ABI/API eligibility and conformance tests; preserve reference binaries and regression workloads; budget compatibility engineering, runtime distribution and support. Staffing, funding and validation remain explicit launch readiness gates.
forward_compatibility_commitment.status: Official scenario commitment at NCC 1980; future fulfilment is not established evidence.

mouse_update.scope: Driver and TUI library/service update; preserve existing OS/core identity and keyboard interface. Standard-control applications need no source edits, subject to linkage and runtime compatibility.
